title: Spicy Kimchi Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy gluten-free stir fry with spicy kimchi and a variety of vegetables.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced pork and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the pork from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped kimchi to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the bean sprouts, scallions, and cooked pork back into the skillet.
Stir in the soy sauce and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Serve the kimchi stir fry over the cooked rice.
Garnish with additional scallions if desired.
